subject: how to download the plots from app using downloadHandler

messages.author: 5fe1ec6d5cb2a6cf
messages.subject: how to download the plots from app using downloadHandler
parts:
Hi,
Although there were several posts regarding the downloadHandler, I am still not sure how it works.
In my case, I have two simple plots using ggplot2.

server = function(input, output) {      
      output$plot1 <- renderPlot({
        p <- ggplot(pred, aes_string(x=input$x, y=input$y))+ geom_point(colour="blue"))
      print(p)
)}
  output$plot1 <- renderPlot({
        p <- ggplot(pred, aes_string(x=input$covariate, y=input$parameter))+ geom_point(colour="blue"))
      print(p)
)}

output$downloadPlot<-downloadHandler(
        filename = function() {
          paste('plot', '.png', sep='')
        },
        content=function(file){
          png(file)
          print()
          dev.off()
        },
        contentType='image/png')
  
}

It seems the download button is not linked to my plots. Could anyone give me some suggestion in this case? Thanks a lot.

messages.author: 129e07bdb789652f
messages.subject: Re: how to download the plots from app using downloadHandler
parts:
Hi, 

Use a reactive conductor:

Plot1 <- reactive({

ggplot(pred, aes_string(x=input$covariate, y=input$parameter))+ geom_point(colour="blue"))
})

output$plot1 <- renderPlot({
      p <- Plot1()
      print(p)
)}

output$downloadPlot<-downloadHandler(
        filename = function() {
          paste('plot', '.png', sep='')
        },
        content=function(file){
          png(file)
print(Plot1())

dev.off()
        },
        contentType='image/png')
}
